user.title: Add an RTSP camera
user.description: Enter the camera's RTSP address. The stream is tested before saving.

data_description.host: IP address or host name of the camera, e.g. 192.168.1.50.
data_description.path: The part after the address, e.g. live0 for rtsp://192.168.1.50/live0.

error.cannot_connect: Could not get video from the camera. Check the host, port and path, and that RTSP is enabled on the camera.
error.invalid_auth: The camera rejected the username or password.
error.stream_not_found: The camera has no stream at this path. If it just restarted, wait a few seconds and try again.

abort.already_configured: This camera stream is already added.

data_description.min_percent: Percent of the picture that must change to detect motion. Higher = less sensitive.
data_description.pixel_threshold: How much a pixel's brightness (0-255) must change to count. Raise it if camera noise triggers motion.
data_description.compare_seconds: Each frame is compared with the frame from this many seconds earlier. Longer catches slow or distant movement better; 0 = the previous frame.
data_description.confirm_frames: Frames to wait to confirm a change is still there. Filters out one-frame video glitches. 0 = off.
data_description.hold_seconds: Motion stays on this long after the last change.
data_description.ignore_areas: Areas to ignore, as x,y,width,height in percent of the picture, separated by ';'. The default 65,0,35,12 is the top-right corner, where many cameras show a clock. Empty = watch the whole picture.
